My heart swells with pride as I realize there is no single place in these sun-drenched woodlands that holds this title. Here, in this realm of roaring felines and silent beasts, lies the true capital of Australia—a place not marked by map or compass, but by the relentless rhythm of my own paws upon the earth. It is a kingdom where kings and queens reign supreme, and the sun climbs high above the canopy, illuminating every living thing with its fiery gaze. This is my world, this is my domain, and here I am, the tiger, ruler of these sun-blessed lands.
